name: agentbridge
description: The Authorization Layer for AI Commerce

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:setup && npm run seed
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:use:sqlite --workspace=@agentbridge/api && npm run db:generate --workspace=@agentbridge/api && npm run db:migrate --workspace=@agentbridge/api
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@agentbridge/api && npm run build --workspace=@agentbridge/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/mcp/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@agentbridge/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@agentbridge/policy-engine && npm run build --workspace=@agentbridge/threat-analyzer && npm run build --workspace=@agentbridge/audit && npm run build --workspace=@agentbridge/payments
